messages:
Ana: heads up — support flagged a customer hitting repeated 413s on /v1/embeddings when sending mixed-dim batches (3x128, 2x768). Console just shows 'payload too large' which isn't actionable.
Ben: ugh. We should show per-item estimated token/byte sizes and a suggestion to split. Also consider adding a 'shape adapt' preflight that returns a splitter plan.
Chris: +1. Routing policy caveat: if splitter suggests 2 shards across different node types we need to account for quota charging and routing hints. Router currently treats splits as independent full requests and double-charges quotas.
Dina: proposal: console should surface `Estimated request size: 1.2MB (split into 2 shards)` with buttons: [Enable auto-split], [Download split plan]. A/B test to 5% first.
Ben: quick telemetry dump — we've seen ~2.3k 413s in last 24h, ~60% from mixed-dim uploads. Example payload header snapshot: 

```
X-Embed-Count: 5
X-Embed-Dims: [128,128,128,768,768]
Estimated-bytes: 1.2MB
Preferred-split: [[128,128,128],[768,768]]
```

Ana: API suggestion: add optional preflight header `X-Embed-Preflight: true` that returns `split_plan` and `estimated_bytes`. Router and console can use this to preview without consuming regular quota.
Chris: important: preflight must be free/noop for billing and not count against rate-limits. Also include telemetry tag `preflight=true` so dashboards exclude it from cost metrics.
Dina: console UX: add an "auto-split" toggle with a tooltip: "server-side split to avoid client-side retries; final shards are billed, preflight is free". Show a small inline example of how requests will be split.
eng-metrics-bot: telemetry-snapshot: 24h mixed-dim 413s=2300, preflight-requests=0 (n/a), avg-split-shards=1.9
Ana: plan: implement preflight header + route hints + console canary. Owners: @Ben (router/preflight), @Chris (quota accounting + tests), @Dina (console UX + canary). Rollout: 5% x48h -> 25% -> 100%.
Ben: i'll open a PR for router change and a stubbed preflight response shape. PR will include a small e2e script to validate no double-charge.
Chris: i'll own quota tests: unit + integration with router simulation and add telemetry flags. ETA 4d.
Dina: will mock UI and add canary flag in console repo; will prepare a short help-blurb for support.
Ana: thanks all — this should cut a bunch of noisy 413s and make the console actionable. :thumbsup:
